description_en: Creates a firewall rule for a simple application server
description_zh: 为指定的轻量应用服务器创建一条防火墙规则
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open create-firewall-rule --instance-id ace0706b2ac4454d984295a942130000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --rule-protocol TCP --port 3306/3306 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateFirewallRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the simple application server
parameters.help_zh: 指定的轻量应用服务器的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application server
parameters.help_zh: 指定的轻量应用服务器所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The transport layer protocol. Valid values:

TCP

UDP

TCP+UDP

ICMP
parameters.help_zh:
传输层协议。取值范围：

TCP：TCP协议。
UDP：UDP协议。
TCP+UDP：TCP和UDP协议。
ICMP: ICMP协议
parameters.name: rule_protocol

parameters.help_en:
The port range.

When the transport layer protocol is TCP and/or UDP, the port range is 1 to 65535. Specify a port range in the format of \<start port number>/\<end port number>. Example: 1024/1055, which specifies the port range from 1024 to 1055.

When the transport layer protocol is ICMP, the port range is -1/-1, which indicates all ports
parameters.help_zh:
端口范围。
TCP/UDP: 端口的取值范围：1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口，例如：1024/1055表示端口范围1024~1055。
ICMP: -1/-1。代表全部端口
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The remarks of the firewall rule
parameters.name: remark
